Inspired by theater acoustics, Motion X600 has 5 drivers and 5 amplifiers positioned to deliver sound all around you, so it feels like you are in the room with your favorite artist.
Whether you are having a party or just enjoying your favorite tunes, the 50W sound fills any space with rich, high-quality audio.
Portable and lightweight, Motion X600 is easy to carry between rooms and turns any part of your home into an immersive listening space.
Enjoy up to 12 hours of music and podcasts on a single charge.
IPX7 waterproof protection lets you relax and listen without worrying about the speaker getting wet.
For peak performance, use the soundcore app and update to the latest firmware.
